newsitem.title: USA: Innkeepers USA raises $133 mln from offering.
newsitem.headline: Innkeepers USA raises $133 mln from offering.

text.p: Innkeepers USA Trust said Tuesday it completed a public offering of 9.5 million shares of common stock at $14 per share, raising gross proceeds of about $133.0 million.
The size of the offering was increased from the originally planned 8.5 million shares.

The company said it will use proceeds from the offering to repay debt incurred in connection with the recent acquisition of certain hotels from Summerfield Hotel Corp and for general corporate purposes.
Lehman Brothers Inc, Montgomery Securities, Bear, Stearns & Co Inc, Alex Brown & Sons Inc, EVEREN Securities Inc and Salomon Brothers Inc served as the managing underwriters for the offering.
Innkeepers USA Trust owns upscale extended-stay hotels.
